views.title: Drawphone

summary: Drawphone (a game like Telephone, but with pictures). Saved 4 views: (1) archive: the 'Your Previous Results' list, grouped by date; (2) result-detail: one past game's results, opened by clicking an entry in the archive (first word, players' drawings, guesses); (3) main-menu: the home screen with the announcement card, Join/Start Party and the links; (4) lobby: the friends' lobby at /?rocketcrab=true&name=Sam&code=kiwi, with the player grid and the options the host controls. The in-game drawing screen (prompt, canvas, colours, brush size, Undo/Redo/Done) is reachable: Start Party, pick a word pack, add 3 bots, then Start Game. It could not be saved because each new game gets a random code in its URL, so the replay always reached a different URL. Text similarity was 0.90, but the URL didn't match. The guessing and waiting screens weren't tried because they come after the drawing screen and have the same problem. Side effect: every replay of the lobby view joins 'kiwi' again as 'Sam', so the replayed lobby showed Sam twice.
